name: review_422_out_of_hunk
notes: The E2/AC-18 case: GitHub rejects the whole batched review because one comment's line is not part of the diff — here the anchor line 91 chosen for the `f-nearest-boundary` finding, whose hunk map was built from a diff fetched before the branch moved. `errors[]` names the offending comment by path and line, which is what lets T6 demote exactly that one comment a rung, retry the whole review once, and re-assert the conservation invariant afterwards.

errors.message: line must be part of the diff
